in_sanskrit.name: निमय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Nimay could be derived from the Sanskrit word 'nimaya,' which means 'measure,' 'calculation,' or 'estimate.' It could suggest someone who is skilled in making measurements or calculations, or someone who is reliable and trustworthy in making estimates.

in_hindi.name: Nimay
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Universe
in_hindi.long_meaning: Nimay एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nimitta', meaning 'indicator' or 'deity'. In Hindu mythology, Nimay refers to the divine architect and creator of the universe, Lord Brahma.

in_tamil.name: Nimay
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lord of the Universe
in_tamil.long_meaning: Nimay ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nimitta', meaning 'indicator' or 'deity'. In Hindu mythology, Nimay refers to the divine architect and creator of the universe, Lord Brahma.

in_telugu.name: Nimay
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Lord of the Universe
in_telugu.long_meaning: Nimay ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nimitta', meaning 'indicator' or 'deity'. In Hindu mythology, Nimay refers to the divine architect and creator of the universe, Lord Brahma.

in_marathi.name: Nimay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nimay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nimitta', meaning 'indicator' or 'deity'. In Hindu mythology, Nimay refers to the divine architect and creator of the universe, Lord Brahma.

in_bengali.name: Nimay
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nimay একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nimitta', meaning 'indicator' or 'deity'. In Hindu mythology, Nimay refers to the divine architect and creator of the universe, Lord Brahma.
